blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY, Philippines — Fresh from a grueling 30-day training on close-quarters combat and hostage rescue, 94 newly minted Army privates are officially joining the ranks of the 10th Infantry Division to bolster its territorial defense operations in Mindanao. Maj. Ruben Gadut told the Inquirer the new troopers—93 men and one woman—capped off their 240-hour Operations Orientation Course at the 10th Division Training School in Mawab, Davao de Oro, on Thursday, Nov. 12. The new soldiers underwent rigorous training on tactical maneuverability and battlefield survival, Gadut said. READ: Troops sent to North Cotabato village to pacify warring MILF groups […]...
